name: SRATH
tagline: Independent projects by Tommy Jonas Rath
description: SRATH is the Danish sole proprietorship of Tommy Jonas Rath: the home of the upcoming Baiganyo webshop and independently developed Android apps.
about:
I'm Tommy Jonas Rath. SRATH is my sole proprietorship, registered in Denmark.

I work full time as a software developer. SRATH is where my own projects live: the upcoming webshop Baiganyo, and Android apps I build in my spare time because I enjoy it.
